obligations.summary: Providers of high-risk AI systems must retain automatically generated logs (as referred to in Article 12(1)) for a period appropriate to the intended purpose of the system, and for at least six months, to the extent such logs are under their control.
exceptions: Retention period may differ if applicable Union or national law provides otherwise, in particular Union law on the protection of personal data.

obligations.summary: Providers of high-risk AI systems that are financial institutions must maintain automatically generated logs as part of the documentation required under the relevant Union financial services law governing their internal governance, arrangements, or processes.
